scope_note: Every raw field is classified against every KNOWN_VALID_SCHEMA_VARIANT in r1_source_schema_registry_v1.json; a rule proven for one variant is not assumed to hold for another without independent evidence.

trade_stream_fields.target: DailyMarketEvidenceV1.first_source_timestamp_utc / last_source_timestamp_utc (per-trade timestamp retained in the min/max reduction, not the aggregate alone)

trade_stream_fields.reconstruction_rule: not needed by any of open/high/low/close/base_volume/quote_turnover/trade_count under the frozen R1 operations; side is a taker-direction label, not a price/size/turnover input
uptick/downtick label; no frozen R1 operation reads microstructure tick direction

trade_stream_fields.target: redundant-field cross-check only (not a stored normalized field)
trade_stream_fields.reconstruction_rule: grossValue == foreignNotional * 1e8 with zero reconstruction error, verified on every row of every r1_bounded_evidence_retention_candidate_v1.json pilot object (5 objects, 2021-2026). NOT globalized beyond the pilot sample: this equality is asserted only for objects that have actually been checked; a future object failing the check is REDUNDANT_FIELD_MISMATCH (an anomaly_trigger), not silently accepted.

homeNotional == size exactly, verified on every row of every pilot object (5 objects). Deterministic reconstruction rule: homeNotional := size. Same globalization caveat as grossValue -- verified on the pilot sample only, re-checked per object via the redundant-field cross-check anomaly trigger, not assumed globally true.
foreignNotional == size*price exactly, verified on every row of every pilot object (5 objects). Deterministic reconstruction rule: foreignNotional := size*price. Same globalization caveat as above.

observed only once (2026-06-30 DOLOUSDT pilot object); semantic meaning not yet documented from an authoritative Bybit source; must not be discarded until its meaning and any downstream relevance are established. Recorded verbatim as a diagnostic column pending resolution, never silently dropped.

funding_stream_fields.field: predicted_funding_rate (documented in the Tardis derivative_ticker free-sample schema)
funding_stream_fields.reconstruction_rule: explicitly forbidden as a funding_settlement source by r1_source_precedence_freeze.json (predicted funding or funding-interval projection is a forbidden derivation)

funding_stream_fields.target: corroboration only, not the canonical settlement_timestamp_utc source
funding_stream_fields.reconstruction_rule: primary source remains the official Bybit realized funding-history endpoint per r1_source_precedence_freeze.json

funding_stream_fields.field: open_interest, index_price, mark_price (Tardis derivative_ticker free-sample fields)
funding_stream_fields.reconstruction_rule: not required by any locked R1 operation; these are corroboration-only fields for a source explicitly ranked below the official realized settlement

current_metadata_fields.field: symbolId, status, contractType, launchTime, deliveryTime, fundingInterval (current Bybit instruments-info)
current_metadata_fields.reconstruction_rule: never used to establish historical eligibility, launch, or terminal events (r1_source_precedence_freeze.json forbidden clauses)
